purpose: Dedicated searchable view of recent system-wide audit entries, formerly presented on the admin page.
primaryGoal: Inspect recent changes by time, action, resource and details; search loaded entries and export matching loaded rows.

dataSources.ownership: System audit backend; admin-wide, not per-user notifications. Query key ['audit-logs']; queryFn forwards AbortSignal; select safeArray. No page-supplied limit, offset, date or vehicle scope; inherited cache/retry policies were not inspected.
dataSources.response: internal\api\audit\log_handler.go:26-50 reads id, ts, actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, detail, descending ts with a capped limit. internal\models\system\system.go:326-334 defines exact JSON tags. Frontend AuditLogEntry instead expects createdAt/resource/details and a string id.
dataSources.knownLimits: Backend accepts limit capped at 200; this handler does not use offset or date bounds. UI pagination and search are local to fetched rows, not full audit history. Query failure returns HTTP 200 [] and scan failures skip rows.

dataSources.ownership: Client-side case-insensitive trimmed substring search over action/resource/details; nullish data becomes []. Search state is component-local. SearchInput buffers typing for 250ms and persists recent searches under historyScope='audit'.
Shared trust adapter; fatalError only replaces no-data failures, retained refresh errors remain visible beside StaleRefreshWarning. Page does not provide a max-age or historical provenance override.

Display-only central formatter. Current caller supplies no locale/timezone overrides, so browser locale/timezone applies; invalid or missing timestamps become an em dash. No physical SI values are present in the audited page.

components.name: PageLayout
components.role: Existing PageContainer adapter with full-width min-w-0 container; no replacement page-layout engine required.

components.name: GlassPanel / PanelTitle / Text / Button
components.role: Surface, typography and retry primitives; page consumes category imports.

components.name: DataTable
components.role: Canonical persistent table, local pagination, visible-column CSV/JSON export, mobile column allow-list and horizontal scrolling.

components.name: SearchInput / FilterBar / ActiveFilterChips
components.role: Shared debounced search/history, wrapping filter cluster and announced filter removal; no new filter composite needed.

components.name: FadeIn
components.role: Existing motion-preference-aware entrance; reduced initial=false source present, runtime not exercised.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page hand-composes alert text/retry and plain-text empty/no-match states while shared feedback primitives already exist. This audit does not establish duplication with another production page.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing QueryError/EmptyState where their contracts preserve error detail, retry, search-reset and current persistent section; do not add AuditErrorCard or another empty-state implementation.

sourceEvidence: AuditLogPage.tsx:93 uses fixed p-6 panel spacing; search at 125 is w-full then sm:w-72.
FilterBar.tsx:29-33 wraps controls; time/details render whitespace and break-word handling at AuditLogPage.tsx:58,77.
AuditLogPage.tsx:150 keeps all four columns in mobileColumns; DataTable.tsx:237-248 documents horizontal-scroll strategy, not a card transform.
DataTable.tsx:505 enables mobile adapter only when mobilePresentation is provided; this page supplies none. No information-loss column hiding is requested by the caller.
requiredAcceptance: Open history and table column/export menus
responsive.risk: Four retained columns and p-6 reduce usable space at 320px. Do not declare overflow or target-size failure without mounted measurement; preserve every field through the existing table pipeline.

accessibility.status: keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast and touch targets unverified
sourceEvidence: AuditLogPage.tsx:95,107 hides decorative icons; fatal error Text has role=alert at 106.
SearchInput.tsx:244-270 supplies a persistent accessible name from ariaLabel/placeholder and a history combobox keyboard model; no unnamed-search finding.
ActiveFilterChips.tsx:141-162 supplies removal announcements and Backspace/Delete removal.
DataTable.tsx:923-930 falls back to stable tableId when no caption/name is supplied.

findings.detail: The table supplies no localized caption/name, so its accessible name falls back to the machine persistence key 'audit-logs' (DataTable.tsx:929-930). It is named, but not with the localized visible context.
findings.fix: Provide a localized existing DataTable caption/name without changing tableId, exportFilename or persistence keys.

findings.detail: History-entry selection buttons remove focus outlines and provide hover/active styling but no explicit focus-visible treatment in their own class list. The active index is changed by input arrow keys or mouse enter, not a button focus handler; actual composed focus visibility is unverified.
findings.fix: Shared owner should verify tab-focus visibility on history options and use the canonical focus token if needed, preserving combobox navigation, removal, selection and return-to-input behavior.

states.initialLoading: Five h-8 skeleton rows at page:99-103 while no retained data and query.isLoading.
states.empty: Localized no-entries text at 162-165; panel/title remain mounted.
states.noMatches: Localized no-match text at 156-159; search and clear chips remain available.
states.fatalError: Localized error with technical message and retry at 104-116; no destructive action.
states.refreshError: Retained data remains; StaleRefreshWarning at 91 supplies source-local retry and polite status. Empty retained arrays also count as data in shared trust derivation.
states.offline: Retained paused queries are explained by StaleRefreshWarning; no-data paused queries have a source-confirmed misleading empty fallback risk.

findings.detail: The initial branch tests query.isLoading, not trust status initial. A pending paused/offline query has no retained data, no fatalError and isLoading=false; StaleRefreshWarning returns null without data (StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:64), then page:162 says 'No audit entries found' although nothing has resolved.
findings.fix: Use existing trust/state presentation for initial unavailable/offline versus resolved-empty, preserve retained rows and retry, and do not convert unknown into an empty audit history.

findings.detail: Database query failure is encoded as successful [] at 35-38; scan errors are silently skipped at 45-47. The page cannot distinguish unavailable or incomplete data from true empty/success through the current response contract.
findings.fix: Report to integration/backend owner for an explicit trustworthy unavailable/partial contract; preserve early-install graceful degradation and do not invent frontend recovery evidence or treat [] as proof of no events.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative clock explicitly uses text-neon-cyan, making neutral historical section chrome a saturated accent with no state meaning.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary theme-relative icon token; retain icon, aria-hidden, title and saved theme choices. Do not introduce a new palette.

visualIssues.detail: Fatal-error text hardcodes text-rose-300 instead of current theme-relative error presentation. This is semantic error color but actual light/dark composed contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current semantic error tokens/feedback primitive, keeping visible message, role=alert and retry.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002 / MDC-045 / API response type validation
architectureIssues.detail: Canonical backend JSON has ts/entity_type/detail (system.go:328,331,333), while page reads createdAt/resource/details at 59,71,78 and searches resource/details at 43. useAdmin.ts:273 merely types request as AuditLogEntry[]; safeArray does not map fields. camelCaseKeys in resilience.ts:26-40 aliases snake_case only, so it cannot manufacture these different names. Source predicts missing time/resource/details and search failures for actual endpoint rows; runtime not exercised. Backend id is int64, frontend interface types string.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should align the existing shared AuditLogEntry and hook/page with canonical response fields, keep nullable detail and entity ID semantics, and retain all four display/search/export capabilities without adding legacy dual-shape adapters or changing raw cache/wire values.

architectureIssues.detail: DataTable is conditionally unmounted on no search matches. Its page-local controller state is destroyed while chips/search remain; preserved tableId storage does not necessarily preserve all transient pagination state. No-match feedback has no direct action, though clear chips/input already supply recovery.
architectureIssues.fix: Prefer existing table emptyMessage/empty presentation or shared source-local empty state with clear search; verify intended pagination reset before changing behavior. Retain visible search/chips, table persistence and loaded-row export scope.

priority.reason: Canonical response mismatch can erase three of four audit fields and defeat search; unknown/offline and backend-error-as-empty semantics affect operator trust. Visual cleanup is secondary.
order: Neutral decorative palette and semantic error presentation

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical audit-entry data contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed numeric id, ts, actor, action, entity_type, optional entity_id/detail matching backend tags; cancellation, safeArray, query key and inherited policies unchanged. Explicit display/search/export mapping rather than alternate wire shape.
usedBy: Assigned AuditLogPage useAuditLogs consumer; other callers not inventoried

requiredSharedChanges.name: Audit unavailable/partial response semantics
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Distinguish valid empty, database unavailable and skipped/partial rows through an agreed existing error/trust protocol; do not fabricate full-history totals or filters.
dependsOn: Existing HTTP error and DataState contracts

requiredSharedChanges.name: SearchInput history option keyboard-focus verification
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing historyScope, controlled value/onChange and debounce APIs; tab-focused option, arrow-active option, remove/clear, Escape and returned input focus must retain canonical focus-visible treatment.
usedBy: Assigned AuditLogPage historyScope='audit'; other history consumers not inventoried

found: Local fatal-error and empty/no-match composition overlaps existing feedback responsibilities; not evidence for a new composite.
reuse: PageLayout, DataTable, shared search/filter/chips, trust warning, date formatting and FadeIn are canonical existing owners.
competingImplementations.notEstablished: No application-wide duplicate inventory or comparison with the distinct admin AuditLogPage was performed.

sectionNames: Four-column audit table and loaded-row export
preservation.sectionCountMeaning: Named capabilities, not six independent panels; one persistent GlassPanel.
actions: Table column/width/density controls from canonical table
CSV/JSON export matching loaded rows and visible columns
dataBehavior: System-wide recent descending-ts list, not notification deliveries or per-user activity
Stable query key ['audit-logs'] and abort forwarding
Retained-data warning must not replace usable rows
Search is trimmed case-insensitive OR matching on three fields
Table key String(log.id), tableId audit-logs and exportFilename audit-logs
All four fields retained on mobile
Optional text uses em dash, not zero
Backend fields/raw metadata must not be discarded in schema correction
No full-history export or server date filtering is currently claimed
preservation.workspace: App.tsx:255,632 mounts the exact assigned route. workspaceScope.ts:23-65 excludes this route from range; :95-107 disables vehicles for /notifications. Page consumes neither selector and creates no competing date/vehicle selector. Preserve fleet/system-wide recent-list scope; adding history bounds would require a separately owned backend integration, not cosmetic modernization.
preservation.si: No physical measurements/converters here; opaque audit details remain source text and timestamps display through centralized formatter. Do not parse/rewrite detail units or raw cache values.
preservation.behaviorLimits: Schema mismatch is a defect to correct with explicit preservation, not evidence that missing fields may be deleted. Source only; no mounted feature parity established.

evidenceLimits.visual: UNVERIFIED; no screenshots, viewport, theme, contrast, forced-colors, RTL or text-zoom exercise.
evidenceLimits.validation: No Git, source/shared/queue edits, production mutations, full build, lint, TypeScript or test runs. The audit skill script was read but not run because it includes project TypeScript and this assignment permits read-only source checks only.

sourceChecks.command: Get-FileHash root page -Algorithm SHA256; Get-Content root page line count; regex counts over exact root source

evidenceLimits.scope: Only assigned mounted page and needed dependency excerpts inspected; shared implementation findings are reporting-only, not change authorization. Backend query policy/auth middleware and all other consumers were not exhaustively audited.
